nodes.description: Owner address state variable of Ownable, granted msg.sender at construction and changed via transferOwnership.
Current joust (round) counter, incremented after 8 participants register.
Number of participants registered in the current joust, incremented on each registration.
Commission constant used in the payout computation (0.024 ether).
Per-rate ether constant (0.3 ether) held in contract state.
Total prize pool constant (2.4 ether) used to derive the per-captcha payout.
Nested mapping of joust/participant structs holding user address, coincidences and winnings.
Mapping of joust history records containing amounts and captcha strings.
Aggregate count of correctly matched captcha characters for the current joust, used as payout divisor.
Per-captcha payout amount computed as (TotalRate - Commission) / AllCaptcha.
First captcha string, pseudo-randomly selected in Random().
Second captcha string, pseudo-randomly selected in Random().
Third captcha string, pseudo-randomly selected in Random().
Public captcha counter kept in state, never updated.
Public state variable initialised to tx.gasprice.
Public state variable initialised to block.difficulty.
Scratch state variable storing the last computed winning amount.
Array of numeric captcha characters '0'-'9' used as captcha alphabet.
Array of letter captcha characters 'a'-'f' used as captcha alphabet.
Random index derived from blockhash used to pick Ast.
Random index derived from block.timestamp used to pick Bst.
Random index derived from block.timestamp used to pick Cst.
SafeMath.mul, overflow guarded by assert(c / a == b).
SafeMath.div, plain integer division without zero check.

SafeMath.add, overflow guarded by assert(c >= a).
Ownable constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded body.
Privileged owner transfer, onlyOwner guarded, writes the owner state variable.
Privileged registration entry point that fills BJJtable and rotates the joust when 8 participants are reached.
View helper returning the CoincidNum recorded for a joust/participant pair.
Unrestricted function slicing an ascii string and incrementing coincidence counters when characters match the captcha.
Unrestricted payout routine computing BetOverlap via division and writing winnings for all 8 participants.
Unrestricted routine converting participant addresses to ascii, running the captcha check and distribution.
Helper mapping a nibble to its ascii character.
Unrestricted pseudo-random captcha generator using block.blockhash and block.timestamp.
Privileged selfdestruct of the contract sending the balance to msg.sender.
msg.sender, controls ownership checks, selfdestruct beneficiary and captcha math via address conversion.
block.timestamp, used as entropy source for captcha randomisation.
selfdestruct(msg.sender) permanently destroys the contract and forwards all ether.

Winning = CoincidNum * BetOverlap arithmetic producing participant payouts.

normalization_plan.reason: _address is only used to write the participant record and carries no independent behaviour.
_n is a pure index argument of the view function and can be absorbed into it.
_n2 is a pure index argument of the view function and can be absorbed into it.
str is the immediate input string of substring with no standalone semantics.
startIndex only parameterises the slicing loop inside substring.
endIndex only parameterises the slicing loop inside substring.
Jnum is used only as the BJJtable joust key inside substring.
Usnum is used only as the BJJtable participant key inside substring.
newOwner is the sole input of the privileged owner write.
a is a trivial operand of the SafeMath multiplication helper.
b is a trivial operand of the SafeMath multiplication helper.
c exists only to hold the intermediate product inside mul.
a is a trivial operand of the SafeMath subtraction helper.
b is a trivial operand of the SafeMath subtraction helper.

b is a trivial operand of the SafeMath addition helper.

lo is a transient nibble of the ascii conversion.
